title: The tower
steps: Months have passed, and it is the last day of the year. Your trunks are half packed. And you, {wizard}, fly with Arvelia's broom racing team now!

The three of you still keep your secret. The black threads sleep in a tin box of {friend}'s, the cold voice has not been heard again, and the older pupil from the edge of the field turns down another corridor whenever he sees you.
I very nearly won that race, you know. The one who never flies, you say? Him? Rinlo, from my year. You wouldn't get him on a broom if you tied him to it.

"With what? Three threads in a box prove nothing," answers {friend}. You climb the long winding stair to the highest hall of the castle: a circle in the floor, an enormous book on a lectern, and Bimo asleep beside the book.
Today each of you is given a familiar. *(You look round: there is not a single creature.)* There are none here, no. A familiar is not chosen. It is described.

What you describe, the spell *minka* will call into the circle. In there it is only a trial: it is not alive, and it comes undone by itself. Try as often as you like. You are first-years: the book allows you six kinds of creature, in their natural colours, a name and nothing more. The rest will come in other years.
But the one that leaves the circle will have a soul, and will live. That cannot be undone. Let no one take out of the circle a creature they have not thought out well.
*("What if I don't like any of them?" whispers {mate}. And Bimo, without opening his eyes:)* Miaow.
